label: Wabi-Sabi

traits.texture: chalky plaster-like grain, worn irregular edges and restrained natural imperfections
traits.composition: simplify the reference into a sparse asymmetrical arrangement with large quiet areas and irregular organic contours
traits.lighting: soft raking daylight, muted earth colors and low contrast

review_checks: Material wear feels restrained and natural
Asymmetry and empty space create a quiet composition
Key source forms remain legible after simplification
limitations: A broad visual interpretation of weathering and restraint; it does not represent the full cultural or philosophical meaning of wabi-sabi.
Palette, fine geometry and cross-image consistency require visual review; generation is not deterministic.
